scope: Read-only executable regression: v1.71 standalone tester behavior versus the v1.70 prefix; no new strategy or tester run was executed for this comparison.
limitations: The v1.70 baseline has a later requested end. Both streams are matched only for information actually available before 2020-10-10; bar_time alone is not used as availability.
TEST_END and explicitly identified native end-of-test forced closes are excluded from normal strategy action/deal matching and retained separately.
This bounded regression does not test optimizer throughput or certify all symbols; those are separate QA artifacts.
